verdict_a_reason: The shared hook now withholds on navigation and keys admitted results by tab, top-frame documentId, and URL. Several consumers use it. Same-URL old-document attribution is still possible in migrated event and extension-run paths, and the repair report explicitly leaves Scrape, Screenshots, Highlights, Showcase shell, App context, fixtures, integrated compile, and native Chrome proof open.

findings.title: Ordinary network capture admits delayed events from the old document into a new same-tab capture
findings.evidence: src/hooks/use-network-capture.ts:58-67 compares the current session pageKey only to the current hook snapshot, then checks event.tab_id. src/lib/background/bootstrap.ts:554-565 stamps tab_id but no trusted sender.documentId; CapturedNetEvent has no document field (src/lib/data-pattern/network-tap.ts:16-33). After B starts on the same tab, a queued A response carries the same tab ID and passes the B filter.
findings.required_fix: Stamp trusted sender.documentId on the SW relay and require it to equal the session documentId before appendEvent; retain the existing tab/session guards. Prove a delayed A event delivered after B Start cannot appear in B's response list.

findings.title: Data picker can save selectors returned by the old document after a new pick starts
findings.evidence: src/features/data/DataView.tsx:123-145 accepts DATA_PICKER_RESULT/EXIT by pickTabRef only; :165-174 installs the new picker and resets that same tab ref. src/lib/background/bootstrap.ts:521-540 rebroadcasts only tab_id. A delayed A result arriving after B's picker starts can replace B's pickedFields and be saved by :181-201.
findings.required_fix: Give the Data picker a document-bound session identity from its content-script result through the SW relay to DataView, and admit only the currently active session and document. Exercise A result after B picker start, then Save.

findings.title: Framework read and run lose the resolved document target
findings.evidence: src/features/showcase/tabs/FrameworkTab.tsx:43-53 calls readFrameworkSources(tab.id) and accepts by pageKey only after the call. src/lib/data-pattern/framework-sources.ts:79-86 injects into {tabId}. The framework mode's runInExtension path reaches readFrameworkSources (framework-sources.ts:148); src/lib/data-pattern/run-pattern.ts:68,118 invokes runInExtension(tabId,config) without its documentId argument. A replacement between click and injection can read B under an A operation before identity refresh.
findings.required_fix: Thread required documentId through the framework extension-run interface and its source read, target the exact document in executeScript, and keep post-await admission. Exercise replacement before injection for both tree dump and extract.

findings.title: Unresolved identity leaves visible controls with silent no-op behavior
findings.evidence: RecipesTab.tsx:52-53 returns without feedback while its button at :136-149 disables only for running or missing tab ID. DataView.tsx:165-166,219-220 similarly returns while run/picker controls at :384-388,:589-590 remain enabled for an unresolved document. PatternsTab.tsx:134-135 returns while PatternRow canRun is Boolean(tab.id) at :262 and :440-442.
findings.required_fix: Expose one reusable identity status/remedy near page-result controls; when identity is unresolved, show why and Retry, or make a click report the remedy. Apply to every migrated page-result action, not only Prepare/Snapshot/SEO.
